title: Mace Backport
description: This plugin adds mace for 1.16.5 version
body:
This plugin adds the mace in 1.16.5 minecraft. You can craft it using breeze rod and heavy core.
You can earn breeze rods by killing blazes and heavy core by killing golems. Breeze rods can be crafted into wind charges. Mace is also have special enchantments like density, breach and wind burst, you can find them in any structures, buried treasures and ruins. Density(I-V) decreases damage per fallen block(0.5 per level). Breach(I-IV) pierces through the target's armour(15% per level). Wind Burst(I-III) Launches attacker upwards upon critical hirring an enemy, allowing for attack streak.
